Knowledge graphs are structured representations of real-world entities and the
relationships between them. They enable machines to reason about facts in a way
that is both human-readable and computationally tractable.

Modern knowledge graphs combine symbolic AI with statistical methods, allowing
for probabilistic reasoning over incomplete or uncertain data.
